title: Plumeform pill button
description: A rounded pill link or button in four fills (ink-or-paper, teal, quiet outline, paper), with an optional thin arrow; it lifts 1px and shifts to teal or mint on hover.
notes: solid is ink on light pages and paper inside dark bands
name: plumeform-button

props.name: variant
props.description:
solid: ink on paper pages, paper on dark bands · plume: the teal brand fill ·
soft: a quiet outlined pill · light: paper fill wherever it sits (e.g. on a teal card)

props.name: arrow
props.description: shows a thin arrow after the label

props.name: block
props.description: stretches to the width of its container

props.name: type
props.description: renders a <button> instead of a link
